summary.text: On Rath, Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew journey through Volrath's Stronghold, battling his creations to rescue imprisoned comrades.
Crovax, cursed to destroy all that he loves after shattering the artifact binding Selenia, strikes her down and is warped into a vampire, then kills Mirri as they fall into Volrath's garden.
Taken to Phyrexia, he is compleated and groomed as evincar of Rath, and he forces Belbe to name him evincar and defeats Volrath in a duel thanks to Ertai.
